examinations.title: Examination Based on the Beatitudes
examinations.description: A spiritual examination of conscience structured around Jesus's teachings on the Beatitudes from the Sermon on the Mount, guiding reflection on how we embody these teachings in daily life.

examinations.title: Examination of Conscience for Children
examinations.description: A simple and child-friendly examination to help children prepare for confession, using language and examples they can understand.
examinations.source: Adapted from Traditional Catholic Teaching for Children

examinations.title: Eucharistic Examination of Conscience
examinations.description: An examination specifically focused on preparing to receive the Eucharist worthily and growing in appreciation of this Most Blessed Sacrament.
examinations.source: Based on Catholic Teaching on the Eucharist

examinations.title: Pope Francis Examination of Conscience
examinations.description: An examination inspired by Pope Francis' teachings on mercy, care for creation, family, social justice, and the joy of the Gospel.
examinations.source: Based on Pope Francis' Teachings and Writings

examinations.title: St. Francis de Sales Examination of Conscience
examinations.description: A gentle but thorough examination focusing on everyday virtues and habits, based on the spirituality of St. Francis de Sales and his 'Introduction to the Devout Life'.

examinations.title: Traditional Examination Based on Ten Commandments
examinations.description: A thorough examination of conscience based on the Ten Commandments, suitable for adults preparing for confession.

examinations.title: Examination Based on Seven Virtues and Vices
examinations.description: A thorough examination of conscience structured around the seven virtues (theological and cardinal) and the seven deadly sins, helping you reflect on your internal dispositions.
